authority: controller instruction '按照你的建議進行' authorizes the recommended corrected rerun protocol before any corrected probe result is observed
claim_boundary: This is a post-freeze corrective execution addendum. It does not claim that the 2026-08-25 prereg record originally contained a probe epoch seed.

epoch_protocol.distribution: EpisodeStartSampler over the frozen train split: date uniform over available file dates and time uniform over [0,86400) seconds, floor-snapped to the frozen decision step
epoch_protocol.matching: one 200-epoch schedule is drawn once; P2 and each P3 policy use all 200 epochs; P7 arms use the same first 100 epochs
epoch_protocol.seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence(master_seed).spawn(4); child index 3 draws episode epochs

historical_scripts.scripts/run_probe_p3.py: 12-episode, one-policy diagnostic only; not a formal corrected-grid entry point
historical_scripts.scripts/run_probes.py: 8-episode smoke diagnostic only; not a formal corrected-grid entry point

master_seed_provenance: retained from the pre-result 2026-08-23 P2/P4/P5/P7 probe runner and P2 artifact; selected before corrected results, not tuned from them

result_policy.c1_comparison_rule: ROUND_HALF_UP the corrected continuous p95 to the three decimal places stored by the frozen resolved literal before testing equality
result_policy.c1_rule: p95 of r1 over served steps under stay-if-possible
result_policy.c3_rule: p95 of abs(r3) over served steps under stay-if-possible, rounded to the nearest integer
result_policy.required_artifact_on_change: a new visible corrective prereg seal that applies the already-declared deterministic mappings
